تستهجنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَهْجِنُوا (tastahjinū) /tas.tah.d͡ʒi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# تُسْتَهْجَنُوا (tustahjanū) /tus.tah.d͡ʒa.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
